newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Internet database streamlines ad data.
newsitem.headline: German Internet database streamlines ad data.

text.p: Munich advertising agency ServicePlan said it wants to make the Internet safe for advertisers with a new central database which monitors the success of advertisements in reaching their target audiences.

With the Plan.Net media system, a product from ServicePlan's subsidiary Plan.Net media, advertisers can see how many people have clicked on their logo, as well as open a database of available Internet ad space, the company said.

"This makes it possible to control and optimise investment in effective Internet advertising," said ServicePlan in a statement. "It knocks down the barriers that stood before many investors for using the Internet as a marketing tool."

By typing in key words and searching the Plan.Net media system database, customers can check if web sites related to their product have free ad space, which the company said delivers ads more directly to target groups.
ServicePlan, one of the top 20 German advertising agencies, said it also offers layout or complete advertisement planning assistance, manages mailing lists and compiles buyer responses for customers.
Plan.Net media said it is collecting advertisement response with the help of several large publishing companies including Gruner + Jahr, Burda and Axel Springer Verlag AG.
